description:
Create a quote. items: [{part_id, quantity, config: {units, process, material, color, finishes, finish_color, services, infill, layer_height}}].
    See get_capabilities for valid ids. Returns prices, speed options with ship/arrival dates, and next_steps.

contact_email.description: Email for receipts and order updates; defaults to the account email
contact_email.title: Contact Email

idempotency_key.description: Same key on a retry returns the first result instead of creating another
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

items.description: Parts to quote, each {part_id, quantity (1-100000), notes?, config: {units, process, material, color?, finishes?, finish_color?, services?, infill?, layer_height?}}
items.title: Items

po_number.description: Your purchase order number, printed on the quote and order
po_number.title: Po Number

ship_to.description: US shipping address: {name, line1, line2?, city, state, postal_code, country: 'US', phone?}
ship_to.title: Ship To

speed.description: Production speed: economy, standard, fast, faster, or fastest (FDM only). Faster speeds add a rush fee; get_capabilities lists each process's speeds.
speed.title: Speed

name: create_quote

outputSchema.description: A priced quote. Fields can be added; none is removed or renamed within v1.

blocking.description: What stops the quote from being ready: {item_id, state, detail}
blocking.title: Blocking

contact_email.description: Email for receipts and order updates
contact_email.title: Contact Email

expires_at.description: ISO 8601. Prices hold until then; a later read re-prices at live rates
expires_at.title: Expires At

free_shipping_remaining.description: Dollars more to reach free shipping (0 when reached)
free_shipping_remaining.title: Free Shipping Remaining

items.description: Lines: {id, position, part, config, quantity, notes, review_status, review_note, pricing, snapshot_url, action_needed?}
items.title: Items

needs_review.description: True while a part waits for manual review; payment is blocked until then
needs_review.title: Needs Review

next_steps.description: Plain-English instructions for what to do next
next_steps.title: Next Steps

number.description: Quote number shown on the PDF and the website
number.title: Number

rate_set_version.description: Version of the price list the quote was priced with
rate_set_version.title: Rate Set Version

ready.description: True when the quote can be paid
ready.title: Ready

share_token.description: Token of the quote's share link, {base}/quotes/share/{share_token}
share_token.title: Share Token

share_url.description: The quote's page on makepartsnow.com, to show a person the parts and prices
share_url.title: Share Url

ship_to.description: Shipping address {name, company?, line1, line2?, city, state, postal_code, country, phone?}
ship_to.title: Ship To

shipping_choice.description: Id of the chosen shipping option
shipping_choice.title: Shipping Choice

shipping_options.description: Carrier options for ship_to; choose one with shipping_option
shipping_options.title: Shipping Options

speed.description: Chosen production speed: economy, standard, fast, faster or fastest
speed.title: Speed

status.description: open, ordered or expired (discarded or past its date)
status.title: Status

tax_note.description: Sales tax is added at checkout
tax_note.title: Tax Note

tiers.description: One entry per speed: price, ship-by and arrive-by dates, eligibility
tiers.title: Tiers

totals.description: Totals for the chosen speed, including total_before_tax
totals.title: Totals

outputSchema.title: QuoteView
